notes.title: Announcing TT Isle of Man - Ride on the Edge 3
notes.content:
Riders, warm up your bikes: get ready to head back to the roads of the Isle of Man with TT Isle of Man - Ride on the Edge 3!

A new "Open Roads" feature has been added and plays a central role in TT Isle of Man – Ride on the Edge 3. Riders can travel freely on 200km (124 miles) of roads around the Isle of Man to find points of interest and challenges to complete, including online competitions as well as weekly and monthly events.

The Steam page will be soon available!

We want to know what you think about the new additions and we can't wait to see you on TT Isle of Man - Ride on the Edge 3!

notes.title: TT Ride on the Edge 2020 - Competition Rules
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36700122/2dcea0fbe145ddaddf9daf840d04f70a74baad5d.png[/img]

Hello Everyone, 

Are you ready for the TT Isle of Man 2020? This is your chance to make your mark on the iconic race by competing in TT Isle of Man - Ride on the Edge 2. The open qualifiers start June 13th for PlayStation 4 and Steam users.

This competition is free for anyone who already has a copy of TT Isle of Man - Ride on the Edge 2 (PS4 or Steam)

[b]Please Note:[/b] In order to run this competition, leaderboards of the (Circuit of Ireland, IOM Track (1lap) and Senior Race  IOM – 6 laps) will be reset in the Superbike category at the time each round starts (only on PS4 and PC). If you’d like to preserve your timing, we recommend taking a screenshot of your best times on the course. 

[h3]FORMAT[/h3]
[b]Open Qualifiers[/b]

The Open Qualifiers start June 13th (9.00 UTC + 1) and run until June 17th (18.00 UTC + 1). To enter, set a time in the Time Trial (Superbike category) on the Circuit of Ireland. The TOP 50 from the combined PS4 & PC Leaderboards (these will be announced on Social Media) will proceed onto Round 2.

[b]Round 2 - Lap of the TT[/b]

Round 2 pits our TOP 50 for one lap on the Isle of Man (set a time in the Time Trial Superbike category). Phase 2 starts on June 20th (9.00 UTC + 1) and will run until June 22nd (18.00 UTC + 1). The TOP 10 (who also competed in the Open Qualifiers) from the combined PS4 & PC Leaderboards (these will be announced on Social Media) advance into the finals. 

[b]The Grand Final[/b]

Our TOP 10 finalists will have to keep up the pace as they take on all 6 laps of the Isle of Man (Quick Race Superbike Category) on June 25th (9.00 UTC+1) to June 26th (9.00 UTC+1). The fastest finalist from the combined scoreboard will be declared winner! 
[h3]Prizes[/h3][list][*] 1st Place: Trip to IOM TT RACES 2021, including travel and accommodation for 2 people
[*] 2nd Place: Official ARAI Helmet TT 2020 Limited Edition
[*] 3rd Place: RST Merchandise[/list]

[b]Settings[/b]

All races will be held in the Superbike category, all riders are allowed. Bike upgrades are allowed (and can be unlocked via the Career mode). All in-game assists are allowed, gears can be set to either manual or automatic. However, the use of any outside tools to influence the outcome of the race will result in disqualification from the tournament. 

[h3]TT Isle of Man - Ride on the Edge 2020 Rules[/h3]
[b]Definition of a rider:[/b] a rider is a person who owns TT Isle of Man - Ride on the Edge 2 on PS4 or PC and puts their time on the leaderboard in the Open Qualifiers and following events. When a rider begins playing on PS4 or Steam, they must continue using this account until the end of the competition.

All riders must follow the given rules and settings, any changes that defer from the outlines below are not allowed. Matches need to be played with the following settings: 

[b]Eligibility of Riders[/b]
Any player on PS4 or PC who owns a copy of TT Isle of Man - Ride on the Edge 2 is able to compete in the TT Ride on the Edge 2020. In the event the grand prize winner is under 18, he/she will need to be accompanied to the final by a parent or legal guardian. 

[b]Structure & Sessions[/b][list][*] Multiple accounts are not allowed (2 or more accounts on the same platform, or different platforms)
[*] Quick Race
[*] Superbike Category
[*] All riders allowed
[*] Gears can be set to manual or automatic
[*] In-game assists are allowed[/list]

[h3]Competition Outline[/h3]
[b]Open Qualifiers[/b][list][*] Start June 13th (9.00 UTC + 1) and run until June 17th (18.00 UTC + 1).
[*] Time Trial (Superbike category) on the Circuit of Ireland. 
[*] The TOP 50 from the combined PS4 & PC Leaderboards proceed onto Round 2.[/list]

[b]Round 2 - Lap of the TT[/b][list][*] Start June 20th (9.00 UTC + 1) and run until June 22nd (18.00 UTC + 1)
[*] Time Trial (Superbike category) one lap on the Isle of Man
[*] The TOP 10 from the combined PS4 and PC Leaderboards proceed onto the Final[/list]

[b]The Grand Final[/b][list][*] Start June 25th (9.00 UTC + 1) and run until June 26th (9.00 UTC + 1)
[*] Quick Race (Superbike category) for 6 laps on the Isle of Man. 
[*] The fastest finalist from the combined scoreboard will be declared winner! [/list]

[b]Prizes[/b]
[list][*] 1st Place: Trip to IOM TT RACES 2021, including travel and accommodation for 2 people
[*] 2nd Place: Official ARAI Helmet TT 2020 Limited Edition
[*] 3rd Place: RST Merchandise[/list]

[b]Fairplay[/b]

In the interest of ensuring fairplay, the admins (Bigben/Nacon and/or Kylotonn Racing Games) have the right amend or add rules at any point throughout the competition.

[b]Severability[/b]

If a provision of this rulebook is or becomes illegal, invalid or unenforceable in any jurisdiction, that shall not affect:

a) the validity or enforceability in that jurisdiction of any other provision of this Agreement

or

b) the validity or enforceability in other jurisdictions of that or any other provision of this Agreement.

[b]Names, Symbols and Sponsors[/b]

Bigben Interactive (Nacon) and/or Kylotonn reserve the right to forbid the use of unwanted or occupied names and symbols in their competitions. Any legally protected words or symbols are generally forbidden unless the owner has explicit permission. No advertisement or promotion of sponsors that are solely or widely known for pornographic, drug use or other adult/mature themes and products is allowed. Additionally any usernames that could be considered inflamatory to groups of people (hate speech etc. are equally banned). 

[b]Note to players:[/b] Once you have started the competition, please do not change your display/username between events else your continued presence in the competition cannot be verified.

[b]Confidentiality[/b]

Any and all communications between league participants and administrators are confidential and no tot be made public by the participant without prior permission by the Bigben Interactive (Nacon) or Kylotonn Racing Games.

[b]Rights of use[/b]

Bigben Interactive (Nacon) reserves the right to use material from all of their matches (i.e. pictures, videos, streams, replays, demos, screenshots, etc.). Players are only allowed to stream their own matches.

[b]Cheating[/b]

Any rider will be disqualified from the tournament if a cheat or abusive exploit is detected. In-game penalties cannot be contested.

[b]Betting[/b]

You are not allowed to bet on any races in this tournament at all.

[b]Behaviour[/b]

Any offensive, disrespectful or unsportsmanlike behaviours (including but not limited to flaming, insults, physical violence) will be punished and can lead to disqualification.

[b]Cancellation & Delays[/b]

In the event of delays or cancellation, riders will be notified by the organiser. 

[b]Changes to the rulebook[/b]

Bigben Interactive (Nacon) / Kylotonn Racing Games are allowed to change or update rules in the existing rulebook at any time.

[b]Server crashes.[/b]

In case of server crashes during an event which would make the competition impossible or altered, organizers will inform the community on social media about the decision to postpone the event, extend it, or reorganise, depending on the severity of the crash.

notes.title: 1.15 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36700122/692bc1387b0971c8e252e34e4fe30c84a21b44f8.jpg[/img]

Riders,

Patch 1.15 is now available, thanks for your patience. Read on for the full patch notes:

[b]Patch 1.15 Notes[/b][list][*] Leaderboards menu page added, allowing you to view more than the first 10 players
[*] The pace in which dirt and bugs accumulate on the helmet has been reduced
[*] Time Attack ghost vehicle has been adjusted, it's transparency adjusts in relation to the player.
[*] All TTs can be done at the end of the season in Career Mode if you qualify to do so[/list]
[b]UI Fixes[/b][list][*] Fixed UI bugs in the loading screen where tracks would be offset from the background
[*] Fixed some instances where headers were displayed incorrectly
[*] Bike parts are no sorted by level in the bike tuning menus
[*] Player names 3D displays have been improved during multiplayer races[/list]
[b]Options[/b][list][*] Fixed an issue where some Post-processing options could not be adjusted
[*] Added an option to toggle whether 3D player names can be toggled on/off in Multiplayer
[*] HUD Ranking options have been renamed (Ranking)[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list][*] Fixed the lap and checkpoint micro-stutters in career races
[*] Fixed an issue where the Careerist achievement would not unlock correctly
[*] Fixed an animation bug in the free ride map
[*] Fixed the media keys not working when the game was fullscreen
[*] Fixed a focus loss bug in free ride and multiplayer modes
[*] Fixed an issue with infinite respawns occurring at the end of the 'Beat the Distance 6' challenge first lap
[*] Fixed a bug with the mail received in career mode
[*] Fixed a bug in multiplayer when the host was disconnected when loading into the race.
[*] Fixed Japanese localization error[/list]

notes.title: TT Isle of Man - Ride on the Edge 2 is NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36700122/3de55556448c7dc7f155a742120aa1f3a1ed870f.png[/img]

Get ready for the most intense road race known to the Isle of Man! Your journey to the TT starts now. 

We've redesigned the game from the ground up, aiming to more faithfully replicate the path that real riders take on the path to Snaefell Mountain. That means rebuilding the physics from the ground up, to more accurately represent real-world racing. We've also overhauled the career mode, to give you multiple paths to Snaefell. The addition of Classic bikes lets you take a step back in time of this historic race. These are just a few of the changes we've implemented, but check it out for yourself. We want to know what you think of the changes, and we want to know what your best time is when you finally make it to the TT!
